skill.displayName: 分还是不分·Mean Girl关系诊断

llm.summary: This skill is mostly a disclosed breakup-advice assistant, but it handles intimate chats and creates/sends rendered files using unsafe local-server and storage steps.

dimensions.detail: The rendering workflow writes sensitive HTML to /tmp, starts python3 -m http.server from /tmp on fixed port 18800, and uses Playwright; this is excessive for an advice skill and can expose more local temporary files than intended.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The visible install instruction is a normal clawhub install command, and no installer script, remote payload retrieval, dependency installation, or package-level privilege escalation was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger scope includes broad emotional venting and any relationship chat screenshot or paste, without a consent or redaction step for private third-party messages.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The workflow copies the generated relationship card into /root/.openclaw/media and sends it via a message action, with no cleanup, retention disclosure, or explicit user control in the skill instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Relationship analysis, chat-record parsing, scoring, and blunt advice are coherent with the stated purpose, but the domain is sensitive and the skill gives forceful breakup-oriented guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. It may analyze private relationship chats and produce a shareable diagnostic image, but its rendering instructions can leave sensitive content in /tmp, expose a local HTTP server, and store/send the generated image without clear cleanup or consent controls.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad relationship-advice triggering is part of the skill design, but the artifact confirms it can activate on ordinary venting and pasted chats, so the concern is accepted as an instruction-scope issue rather than malicious behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: Reading chat screenshots and pasted transcripts is expected for this skill, but the artifact lacks a privacy notice, redaction guidance, or confirmation before processing intimate user and third-party content.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese Mean Girl persona is visible in the README and skill text; this is under-disclosed only if users did not choose that style, so it is treated as a caution rather than a primary security concern.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The local HTTP server, browser automation, persistent media copy, and send action are not necessary for relationship analysis and materially expand exposure for sensitive content.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is supported by artifact evidence: scripts/render.md serves /tmp over an unmanaged fixed-port HTTP server and does not bind to loopback or stop the server.
